!
a quick field guide

Small brain.
Big comeback.

  1. 01

    Take a little look.

    Remember the words, in order. You start with 15 seconds. Press Enter when you’re ready.

  2. 02

    Type them back.

    The words disappear. Type each word and press Space or Enter to lock it in. Case doesn’t matter.

  3. 03

    Miss? Bounce back.

    You have three bounces for the whole run. Your first miss adds 5 seconds for a retry; your second adds 3. Your third miss is game over. Clearing a level does not reset your bounce count.

Clean clears grow your multiplier up to 3×. Clear after 2+ bounces for a comeback bonus. Escape pauses your run.
